jobs.description:
Company Activities:

Join a company committed to excellence in maritime operations. Our client prides themselves on their dedication to safety, innovation, and teamwork. Their mission is to deliver top-notch dredging services with a focus on environmental sustainability and client satisfaction. As part of their team, you’ll be contributing to projects that shape the waterways of northern Europe, ensuring they remain navigable and efficient for all maritime traffic.

Jobomschrijving

Are you a skilled Captain for Tugboat looking for an exciting opportunity to showcase your expertise? Join our client’s dynamic team and navigate the waters of northern France and Belgium. Your primary mission will be to provide essential support to a dredging pontoon, ensuring smooth operations and safe passage through these regions.

Key Responsibilities:

• Navigate and operate the tugboat efficiently in collaboration with dredging operations.
• Ensure the mechanical upkeep of the tugboat, supported by the client’s team of technicians.
• Maintain tidiness and order on board, ensuring a safe and pleasant environment.
• Coordinate with French-speaking and Flemish-speaking teams to ensure seamless communication and operations.

Profile Description:

Our client is seeking an independent and responsible individual to take on the role of Captain for Tugboat. The ideal candidate will possess:

• A strong mechanical knowledge, essential for the maintenance and operation of the tugboat.
• CRR holder credentials.
• A driving licence and access to a car for easy mobility.
• A B licence (river) and A licence (river   coastal) to navigate various waterways.
• Proficiency in English, French, or Dutch to effectively communicate with diverse teams.

Our client is an international environmental services company dedicated to protecting the planet with sustainable mobile filtration solutions for liquids and gases.

They have approximately 450 employees, united as Generation D., all committed to driving positive ecological change across various industries.

Jobomschrijving

What does a Process Operator ?

Quality responsibility – You ensure the optimal production of high-quality reactivated carbon by precisely adjusting process parameters to maintain excellent production output.

Operational responsibility – You start up, operate, monitor, and shut down various technical installations to ensure uninterrupted production.

Problem-solving – When technical malfunctions occur, you analyze the cause and perform necessary repairs or adjustments to maintain production efficiency.

Process optimization – You actively contribute ideas for improvements to enhance efficiency and sustainability in production processes.

Forklift operation – You will use a forklift for various tasks, ensuring a smooth and safe production process.

Why You?

Are you ready to work in a dynamic and innovative environment where you can continuously contribute to improvements? Then you might be the perfect candidate!

 

Your Team as a Process Operator

You will join a fantastic team of technical operators and forklift drivers in Rumbeke, reporting directly to your team lead.

Who Are We Looking For?

• A strong technical background (mechanics, electricity, etc.) and a passion for technology and innovation.
• Fluent in English and/or Dutch.
• Forklift certification required.
• Analytical and problem-solving skills – You can quickly detect and resolve technical issues.
• Hands-on mentality – You are proactive and not afraid to get your hands dirty.
• Team player – You can work well in a team but are also capable of working independently.
• Flexibility – Willing to work in a shift system.
• Safety-conscious – You always prioritize safety and strictly follow procedures.
• Even if you don’t meet all the criteria but strongly identify with our core values – Teamwork, Excellence, and Devotion – we encourage you to apply!

Our client is building one of the most advanced glass factories in the world in Lommel. This ultramodern site excels in sustainability, automation, and technological innovation. As a TECHNICIAN, you play a key role in the maintenance and operation of this state-of-the-art production environment, where safety, efficiency, and environmental awareness are at the forefront.

Jobomschrijving

Well before the startup, you will begin thorough training in day shifts to fully understand our installations, systems, and standards, enabling you to help set the standard in this unique factory from day one.

Depending on your background (electrical or mechanical), you will be deployed as a technician within one of the maintenance teams. Your tasks will include:

• Analyzing and resolving technical faults in machines and installations
• Performing preventive and corrective maintenance
• Calibrating, adjusting, and checking parts and systems
• Contributing ideas for technical improvements within your department
• Working closely with fellow technicians and operators for safe and stable operation
• Accurately recording interventions in the maintenance system

Profile:

• You have completed technical training or have relevant experience in maintenance
• You are strong in mechanical and/or electrical areas
• You are solution-oriented and enjoy working in a team
• You are skilled in reading technical plans or schematics
• You can work in a day-shift and are looking for a stable, long-term challenge
• You speak good English.

About the Company

Our client is a leading logistics partner for the frozen food sector, serving industries, retailers, and foodservice companies. The company offers specialized frozen storage, inventory management, and logistics solutions, and is known for its stable operations, strong growth, and focus on employee wellbeing.

Jobomschrijving

Are you a hands-on person who enjoys physical work and thrives in a dynamic warehouse environment? Are you accurate, motivated, and not afraid of working in cold temperatures? Then this opportunity is for you!

For a stable and international logistics company in Oostkamp, specialized in frozen food storage and distribution, we are looking for motivated Order Pickers to strengthen the team.

Your tasks include:

• Picking orders using a voice-picking system or scanner
• Checking products for quality and quantity
• Preparing orders for shipment
• Operating a standing Electric Pallet Truck (EPT)
• Handling goods in a frozen warehouse environment (-22°C)

We are looking for candidates who:

• Have experience as an Order Picker 
• Have experience operating an Electric Pallet Truck (EPT)
• Are physically fit and enjoy active work
• Work accurately and follow instructions carefully
• Speak English or Dutch
• Are reliable, motivated, and looking for long-term employment
• Are comfortable working in a frozen environment (-22°C)

Company Activities:

Our client is part of the circular economy based on wood fibers. In Belgium, the company has three units employing around 600 employees. The plant in Langerbrugge (Ghent) produces high-quality newspaper and magazine paper from 100% recycled paper. Thanks to two biomass power plants that provide the necessary process steam and three wind turbines, the company is one of the most sustainable enterprises in North Sea Port. Safety is the top priority, and thanks to intensive training programs, employees develop both professionally and personal

Jobomschrijving

Our client, a leading global producer of renewable solutions for paper, packaging, pulp, and wood constructions, is looking for an Electrical Maintenance Technician. In this role, you will be responsible for managing and maintaining the electrical network up to a voltage level of 150 kV.

Your daily tasks will include:

• Managing the lighting network.
• Maintaining fire detection systems.
• Operating frequency converters (ABB, Siemens, Danfoss).
• Controlling various types of power switches (Siemens, ABB).

The ideal candidate should:

• Hold a Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering or equivalent experience.
• Have several years of experience in a similar role in an industrial production environment.
• Be passionate about electricity and keep up-to-date with the latest trends in the field.
• Think pragmatically and solve problems.
• Plan and organize work effectively, with a focus on achieving results.
• Communicate in English or Dutch at a good level.

Company

Founded in Belgium in 1935, our client has grown into an international leader in sustainable packaging solutions. Their packaging—from corrugated cardboard and solid board to tubes and protective corners—is produced with recycled paper and is 100% recyclable and biodegradable. With a long-term vision and focus on sustainability, they combine ecological and economic progress. Their products, relationships, and management style all contribute to a greener planet. Today, our client has 6,500 employees, spread across 70 locations in 21 countries. The headquarters is located in Aalst.

Jobomschrijving

For the location in Hoogstraten, our client is looking for enthusiastic operators.

Curious about how paper and cardboard are made? With our client, you will learn it all!

As an operator, you play a crucial role in the production process. These are your responsibilities:

• Setting up, operating, and monitoring machines for the production of paper and cardboard products.
• Starting and stopping machines according to prescribed procedures.
• Performing quality checks on products during the production process.
• Ensuring a smooth production process with your colleagues.
• Performing first-line maintenance on the machines.
• Reporting technical malfunctions and working with the technical department to resolve them.
Monitoring the safety instructions and ensuring they are applied in the workplace

Eager to learn and interested in growth opportunities? Then you are the operator our client is looking for!

• Working in a production environment doesn’t scare you, even if it’s noisy.
• You are a handy person with an interest in technology.
• You value safety, order, cleanliness, and quality.
• You are open to feedback and see it as an opportunity to grow.
• You demonstrate responsibility and are always ready to help others.
• You have basic PC skills.
• You will be employed in a 2-shift or 5-shift system.
• You speak good Dutch or English.

About the Company:

Our client is a respected organization where quality, safety, and teamwork are core values. As a VCA**-certified company, they are committed to providing excellent service to their clients while fostering a growth-oriented and supportive environment for their employees. They are looking for individuals who share their passion for excellence and innovation.

Jobomschrijving

At our client’s company, quality and safety are at the heart of everything they do (VCA**-certified). Equally important, however, are their people. Due to their continued growth, they are looking for a motivated Industrial Electrician to make a real difference within their organization.

Your Role:

• Perform on-site interventions at the client’s location in case of issues.
• Take responsibility for repairing reported problems at the client’s site.
• Verify that the actions taken result in the optimal functioning of the equipment.
• Ensure all work is delivered with a focus on safety, efficiency, quality, and timing.
• Act as the main point of contact for the client on-site and provide internal reports to the project manager.
• Collaborate effectively, whether working independently or as part of a team.

Profile Description: 

A technical education in an electrical field (or equivalent through experience).

Strong communication skills in Dutch or English.

A customer-friendly attitude: You prioritize client values and ensure commitments are met.

A flexible mindset: You adapt your approach as needed to achieve goals and handle changes effectively.

A valid driver’s license (Category B).

VCA and BA4/5 certifications are a plus, but not mandatory.

Our client is the world's largest vertically integrated manufacturer of polyurethane foams. The company serves a diverse global marketplace with innovative polyurethane chemical solutions, polyester fibers, and insulation materials. With a network of more than 60 production facilities worldwide, our client has established itself as a global industry leader, recognized for its high-quality products, advanced manufacturing technologies, and commitment to employee development.

Jobomschrijving

As a Machine Operator, you will be responsible for:

• Operating and setting up production machines according to production guidelines and specifications.
• Cutting and processing foam blocks based on customer and production requirements.
• Performing quality checks on finished products, including dimensions, shape, color, and compliance with specifications.
• Using measuring tools during the production process.
• Registering production data and labeling products in the Carpy system.
• Transporting materials and products between workstations using an electric pallet truck.
• Ensuring the proper operation of machinery and carrying out basic maintenance tasks when required.

Requirements

• Previous experience in a production or manufacturing environment.
• Technical aptitude and an interest in operating machinery.
• Ability to work independently with a strong sense of responsibility and attention to quality.
• Good teamwork and communication skills.
• Working knowledge of English or Dutch sufficient for workplace communication.

An SME in the Waasland region known for the production, purchase, and sale of pallets.

Jobomschrijving

Job Description:Are you seeking a new challenge where you can utilize your physical strength and precision? Our client, a renowned company in pallet production, is looking for a Robot Operator for Pallet Production.

As a Robot Operator for Pallet Production, you will be responsible for operating the production robot. Your role includes preparing the workstation: arranging planks and components on the worktable, which are then automatically assembled by the robot. The job requires physical effort, is repetitive in nature, and takes place in a noisy environment. Therefore, we are looking for someone who is up for the challenge.

Your tasks include:

• Preparing and placing planks and components on the worktable.
• Operating and monitoring the production robot.
• Ensuring a safe and efficient work environment.
• Collaborating with the team to ensure smooth production processes.

Profile DescriptionWhat are we looking for?

We are seeking an energetic and physically strong individual who meets the following requirements:

• You are physically fit and comfortable with repetitive tasks.
• You are flexible: until September, you will work in a day shift, and afterward in a two-shift system (morning and afternoon shifts).
• You can communicate in Dutch or English to collaborate effectively with the team.
• You work accurately and have attention to detail.
• You have prior experience in a production environment.

Our client specializes in bodywork and mechanical repairs for all car brands.

Jobomschrijving

Our client is looking for a skilled tinsmith to join their team. You will be responsible for the repair, maintenance, and installation of metal components. As a tinsmith you will play a key role in restoring and repairing vehicles or metal structures.

 

Your Responsibilities:

• Performing sheet metal work, including repairing damaged parts.
• Installing and removing body panels, metal coverings, or structural components.
• Metal processing (bending, straightening, cutting, welding).
• Preparing surfaces for painting or further treatment.
• Following safety regulations and maintaining a clean workspace.

Candidate Profile:

• Minimum 2 years of experience as a tinsmith.
• Proficiency in using sheet metal tools (hammers, welding machines, grinders, etc.).
• Knowledge of materials and techniques used in sheet metal work.
• Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
• Attention to detail and precision in executing tasks.
• Communicative knowledge of English or Dutch.

As a Customer Service Representative, you will take ownership of the entire order-to-delivery process and ensure a seamless customer experience.

Client Details

Our client is a well-established international company active in the consumer goods sector, renowned for its premium products and strong brand reputation across Europe. To support their Customer Service team, they are currently looking for a Customer Service Representative to manage the French or English-speaking market and act as a key link between customers, sales teams, and logistics partners.

Description

As a Customer Service Representative, you will take ownership of the entire order-to-delivery process and ensure a seamless customer experience.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Acting as the first point of contact for customers and the sales team regarding orders and delivery-related matters.
• Processing and managing customer orders accurately in SAP.
• Ensuring correct pricing, promotions, product availability, quantities, and delivery conditions.
• Following up on orders from entry through to final delivery.
• Coordinating deliveries and managing logistics-related queries.
• Resolving issues that may impact order shipment or customer satisfaction.
• Preparing and sharing reports on backorders and open orders.
• Working closely with sales, logistics, and other internal stakeholders to ensure excellent service levels.
• Supporting the onboarding and setup of new customers.
• Contributing to continuous improvement within the customer service process.
 

• Experience in Customer Service, Internal Sales, Order Management, or a similar customer-facing administrative role.
• Good knowledge of SAP is a strong asset.
• Comfortable working with Excel and managing data accurately.
• Fluent in French and English. Additional European languages are considered a plus.
• Strong organizational and problem-solving skills.
• Customer-oriented with excellent communication abilities.
• Proactive and able to work independently while maintaining a strong team spirit.

jobs.occupation: Order To Cash German and English
jobs.description:
Our client is a family business operating since many years in the FMCG non Food Sector.They are located in the Walloon Brabant region.

Jobomschrijving

As an Order To Cash German And English your responsibilities are:

• Process customer orders accurately and keep order information up to date
• Handle customer service queries in German and English, providing clear information on orders
• Follow orders through the order-to-cash process to support timely completion
• Liaise with sales, logistics and finance departments
• Coordinate order-related information with relevant internal contacts
• Check customer and order details to help maintain accurate records
• Resolve routine order issues and communicate updates to customers
• Maintain clear documentation of customer contacts and order actions
• Contribute to a reliable customer service process for the Retail business

A successful Order To Cash German And English should have:

• Ability to communicate clearly in German and English
• A first experience in customer service or order to cash roles is a big plus
• Experience in the retail or hard discount world is a plus (Aldi, Lidl, Kruidvat, Colruyt, ...)
• You are accurate, meticulous and can handle deadlines
• Excellent communication skills with clients, distributors, internal stakeholders, ...
• A team player

jobs.occupation: Recruitment Consultant I Open to Graduates & Junior Profiles
jobs.description:
As a Recruitment Consultant, you will help companies identify their future talent while supporting candidates throughout their career journeys. It's a dynamic, entrepreneurial and people-focused role where no two days are the same.

Client Details

You will be joining the newest division of a global player in the field of recruitment, which has also won the Top Employer award several times in a row.

Description

• Attend presentations and meetings
• Approach a network of customers and candidates
• Persuade them to work with you on their recruitment needs
• Negotiate terms, brief them and advise them on their recruitment needs
• Manage the entire recruitment cycle, from candidate selection to offer management
• Participate in job fairs and universities
 

• You speak Dutch and/or French fluently and have an excellent level of English
• You are a driven, social and entrepreneurial person
• You can work autonomously while remaining a real team-player
• You are a persuasive and compelling person able to sell yourself and the company
• You are adaptable and can change your style of delivery depending on your audience

jobs.occupation: Account Receivable & Credit Officer - Brussels - Food Sector
jobs.description:
Our client is a family-founded multinational company, leader in the global packaged goods industry, known for producing high-quality consumer products. Originating in Europe, the company has expanded its footprint to over a hundred countries, maintaining a strong presence in both mature and emerging markets.

Jobomschrijving

• Verification and recording of accounts receivable data
• Processing of incoming payments
• Compliance with group financial policies and procedures
• Preparation of invoices 
• Management of bank deposits
• Following up with clients to facilitate invoice payments
• Regular communication with clients
• Financial data analysis and report creation
• Monitoring credit-related performance indicators (KPIs)
• Implementation of action plans to ensure the company's financial health

• Minimum 3 years of experience as an A/R Officer or in a similar role
• Trilingual proficiency in Dutch, French, and English, enabling effective communication with diverse stakeholders
• High accuracy and attention to detail in work, especially in record-keeping
• Strong critical thinking skills to support precise and efficient operations
• Proficient in Excel and SAP, with hands-on technical knowledge
• Proactive problem-solver, addressing technical challenges with practical solutions
• Solid experience in credit collection and understanding of its accounting complexities
• Valuable contributor to effective management of accounts receivables

We are looking for an experienced Executive Assistant to provide high-level support to the Director General. This is a key position requiring exceptional organisational skills, professionalism, discretion, and the ability to operate confidently in a fast-paced international environment.

Client Details

Our client is a well-established European association based in Brussels, representing and supporting members across Europe. Operating in an international and multicultural environment, the organisation plays a key role in fostering collaboration, advocacy, and knowledge sharing within its sector.

Description

• Act as the trusted right hand and strategic support to the Director General
• Manage a complex agenda, shifting priorities, and high-level executive commitments
• Coordinate international travel, itineraries, and meeting preparations
• Monitor and manage the Director General's inbox, correspondence, and follow-ups
• Prepare presentations, briefing documents, reports, and executive materials
• Ensure action points are tracked and deadlines are met across multiple projects
• Organise and coordinate Board Meetings, General Assemblies, and leadership meetings
• Take meeting minutes and follow up on agreed actions
• Build strong relationships with members, partners, and key stakeholders across Europe
• Liaise with internal teams to ensure smooth communication and coordination
• Handle sensitive and confidential information with the highest level of discretion
• Maintain accurate records, databases, and executive documentation
• Review expenses, approvals, and administrative processes
• Act as a key point of contact on behalf of the Director General when required
• Support the smooth functioning of the executive office and provide back-up within the administrative team
• Anticipate needs, solve problems proactively, and ensure nothing falls through the cracks
 

• 15 to 20 years of experience in a similar Executive Assistant role
• Previous experience supporting C-level or Executive-level leadership
• Experience within an international organisation, association, federation, or EU environment is highly desirable
• Outstanding written and verbal communication skills in English
• Excellent command of Microsoft Office (Word, PowerPoint, Excel, Outlook)
• Strong organisational and prioritisation skills
• Proactive, resourceful, and solution-oriented mindset
• Highly professional, trustworthy, and discreet
• Eager to learn and continuously improve

Join a prestigious international law firm as a Legal Assistant supporting a Partner, two Counsel, and several Associates within the Antitrust practice. This is a long-term opportunity for an experienced legal support professional who thrives in a fast-paced environment and enjoys being a key contributor to a high-performing legal team.
 

Client Details

Our client is a globally renowned law firm with an outstanding reputation across the UK, the US, and international markets. With offices located worldwide, the firm advises leading multinational organizations on complex legal matters across various industries.

Due to continued growth of the Brussels office and an upcoming move to larger premises early next year, the firm is looking to strengthen its support team with an additional Legal Assistant. You will join a collaborative environment and work closely with another experienced Legal Assistant in a duo setup, ensuring seamless support to the legal team.

 

Description

This position is primarily focused on legal administration and billing support (approximately 90% of the role), with a smaller reception component (approximately 10%).
Legal & Administrative Support
• Manage complex billing processes and prepare client invoices with a high level of accuracy.
• Follow up on billing queries and liaise with lawyers and finance teams when needed.
• Prepare, format, proofread, and finalize legal documents, presentations, and correspondence.
• Manage agendas, schedule meetings, and coordinate appointments.
• Organize travel arrangements and business itineraries.
• Handle document management and maintain electronic filing systems.
• Open new client matters and support conflict check processes.
• Monitor deadlines and assist lawyers with day-to-day administrative requirements.
• Provide support to a Partner, two Counsel, and several Associates within the Antitrust practice.Reception Support (10%)
• Welcome visitors and clients in a professional and courteous manner.
• Answer and redirect incoming calls when required.
• Support the office with occasional front-desk coverage alongside the wider administrative team.
 

• Previous experience as a Legal Assistant, Practice Assistant, Legal Secretary, or similar support position within a law firm is essential.
• Proven experience managing legal billing and invoicing processes.
• Strong administrative and organizational skills with exceptional attention to detail.
• Near-native level of English is mandatory.
• Good working knowledge of either French or Dutch (minimum B1 level).
• Comfortable supporting senior legal professionals in a demanding international environment.
• Proactive, resourceful, and capable of anticipating needs before they arise.
• Professional, discreet, and confident in managing confidential information.
• Team-oriented mindset with the ability to work closely in partnership with another Legal Assistant.
Candidates must already be based in Belgium and have the right to work in Belgium. Visa sponsorship cannot be provided for this position.

Do you have experience in production or a technical background, and are you willing to work in shifts? Do you speak Dutch or English fluently?

• As a Production Worker, you will be responsible for making safety boots.

• Assembling components (steel toe cap, lining and steel sole) onto the mould

• Cleaning the machine

• After completing internal training, you will also be able to operate two other machines

• Experience as a production worker is required

• You are eager to learn and have a strong focus on quality

• You have your own means of transport

• You have a good command of Dutch or English

As an Operator in Hot Kitchen Department, you are responsible for independently operating various production machines. In this department, ingredients and prepared products are fried, cooked, steamed, mixed, and boiled.

Your responsibilities include operating equipment such as cooking kettles, filling machines, mixers, and combi steam ovens. You also prepare dishes and food components in accordance with our quality, hygiene, and safety standards.

 

What does the job involve?

As a Kitchen Operator, you are the right-hand person of the Team Leader in the Hot Kitchen Department, supporting them in the production of prepared dishes and food components.

You are responsible for preparing and carrying out recipes. Your tasks include:

• Taking over the duties of kitchen staff in their absence.

• Carrying out the necessary quality checks on raw materials and preparing them for processing when required. Depending on the workload, you work together with kitchen staff, providing them with clear instructions and guidance to ensure that their tasks are carried out correctly.

• Independently following and executing recipes in accordance with quality standards and IFS requirements.

• Ensuring that industrial equipment is properly cleaned after and between each production run, in accordance with hygiene regulations.

• Preparing spice blends according to the recipes when the Goods Receiving employee is absent.

• Correctly preparing frozen ingredients and recipe components according to the production order.

• Labelling semi-finished products and recording their use in our computer system.

• Recording cooling temperatures.

Requirements:

• You have a very good command of Dutch (speaking, reading, writing, and understanding). A good knowledge of English and/or French is an advantage.

• You are comfortable with basic calculations, reading weights, and using weighing scales.

• You have completed training in a culinary field (institutional catering, chef, catering assistant, or butcher) or have equivalent experience.

• You are familiar with food safety regulations.

• You are able to operate a manual pallet truck.

• You are flexible and enjoy the challenge of switching between different departments.

• You can work well under pressure. Things can get quite busy at Marblo! 

• You maintain a neat and well-groomed appearance. For hygiene and safety reasons, gel nails, excessive make-up, visible piercings, etc., are not permitted in our production areas.
